title: Cernly WebAssembly plugin protocol v1
description: What a WebAssembly plugin (https://cernly.dev/how/plugins/) is given and returns. The module runs under WASI preview 1 with no files, no network, an empty environment, a fixed clock and a fixed random seed. It reads one input object on stdin and writes one output object on stdout. Facts use the vocabulary of scan.v1.schema.json. Built with plugin/sdk.

name.description: Unique among the built-in and loaded plugins

watches.description: Repo-relative globs, the.cernly.yml syntax: a pattern covers a file or any parent folder, ** spans folders, other segments use path.Match. Only tracked, non-excluded files they cover are sent

emits.description: Fact kinds of scan.v1 the plugin may return; any other kind is dropped and recorded

consumes.description: Phase-1 fact kinds the plugin is given; present = a phase-2 plugin (https://cernly.dev/how/plugins/)

tools.description: Narrows consumed stack facts to these tools

key.description: ed25519: and the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the raw public key

sig.description: Base64 ed25519 signature over the bytes "cernly plugin manifest v1\u0000" followed by the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the manifest

facts.description: Phase-1 facts of the consumed kinds, sorted canonically; empty for a phase-1 plugin

Each fact is validated against scan.v1; its evidence may only name files sent or the evidence paths of facts sent; plugin, when set, must be the manifest name. Invalid facts are dropped and recorded as errors

errors.description: Files the plugin could not read; any error makes the run partial
